description: List scenario branches that share a common parent so user-authored alternatives remain navigable and comparable.

include_self.description: Include the queried sim itself in the siblings list (marked is_self:true). Default true.

simulation_id.description: The sim whose siblinghood you want. Its forked_from (if any) selects the group; otherwise its own id is the group key (its direct children).

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: list_siblings
